caltab_points — CALIB target op

• Data kinds: none → keypoints (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.caltab_points(rows=7, cols=7, spacing=1.0) (to call the implementation directly, import caltab; caltab.caltab_points(rows=7, cols=7, spacing=1.0); from the registry, opscalib.get("caltab_points"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Returns the ideal mark coordinates of a calibration plate (world, mm; origin = first mark) as (y, x) (caltab_points).
